review_mode: Independent local read-only source review and focused CPU checks; no GPU, remote-pod access, or source edits
scope: Correction of the Part 2d eager-attention baseline discrepancy; earlier eager evidence preserved

source_findings.attention_selection: Base loader and core model config both select SDPA. Every decoder JVP is scoped inside sdpa_kernel(SDPBackend.MATH), covering completion loss and next-token generation.
source_findings.backward_dispatch: HF gradient checkpointing remains disabled; backward follows the saved math-operation graph and does not rerun attention after leaving the backend context. Chunked CE recomputes only vocabulary projections.
source_findings.fixed_linearisation: Immutable initial LoRA dictionary remains the functional_call primal; only separate delta tensors are optimized. No change to the linearisation point or loss denominator.
source_findings.initial_loss_guard: The first complete logical accumulation group is checked against the original recorded first loss with a 0.5% relative tolerance after gradients are computed but before clipping, optimizer.step, or scheduler.step. A mismatch retains empty history and unchanged zero-delta parameters.
source_findings.resume_guard: Experiment identity/source hashes reject old eager checkpoint/results. Resumed history also rechecks its recorded first loss before further optimizer updates.
source_findings.experiment_identity: Identity now includes attention=sdpa_math and initial_loss_maximum_relative_error=0.005; core metadata names SDPBackend.MATH.
source_findings.delta_checkpoint_identity: Standalone core checkpoints use format_version=2 and attention_backend=sdpa_math; loading requires these plus the same immutable initial-parameter hash.
source_findings.evaluation: Evaluator source is unchanged; the shared core enforces SDPA math for every generation prefix. Existing experiment/delta-file identities bind the new model.
source_findings.output_isolation: Use separately named --out and --arrays-dir paths for the corrected run. Reusing the previous path fails its experiment identity check, preserving the old eager run.
source_findings.earlier_parts: Parts2,2b,2c full-model code already requests SDPA; this correction does not require rerunning those results for the specific eager baseline discrepancy.

core_agent_reported_final_source_cpu_sel.attribution: Reported by the core implementation agent after testing the frozen source; final combined CPU gate is independently run by the root agent.

limits: The final combined CPU gate must be rerun and committed for these exact source hashes before corrected full-model training.
